name: Mutavault — "becomes a 2/2 creature with all creature types" reads the card type it names
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). "This land becomes a 2/2 creature with all creature types until end of turn. It's still a land." parseBecomesType returned only the all-creature-types flag, so the fired ability left Mutavault a Land with no P/T. What stands before "with all creature types" is now read as well: Land Creature, 2/2, every creature type.
